body:
Myk's brief, 2026-08-25 evening, from live MCP testing in the sync: container.

THE PROBLEM, WITH EVIDENCE. The generated mutation types every writable prop as PrimitiveValue and authors primitive deltas. There is no typed path to author an entity-pointer delta; the only pointer surface is raw _claim. Live repro: sync:experience registered with experiencers writable; a cold-connecting MCP client with introspection as its only documentation naturally wrote experiencers: "sync:person:myk" - a string fossil, an inert id that expand can never follow. The repair required folklore (a raw _claim with the symmetric two-pointer shape plus manual retraction), and the correct role/context names exist nowhere in the store - a second client could pick different names and the folds silently diverge. The introspected surface is the entire documentation an MCP agent reads; it currently teaches the wrong thing.

THE DECISION (Myk's). Derive edge mutations from the LENS: an expand node with role {exact: R} feeding a grouped prop P is a machine-readable statement of what a well-formed edge delta looks like. Generate the write side as the adjoint of the read program. One declaration, both directions. REJECTED: a write-schema language (second source of truth, drifts, un-Loamish - the mask validates at read time); a generic delta-factory tool (_claim already is one; it cannot carry schema knowledge, which is exactly the divergence bug). UNTOUCHED: _claim, and the MCP tool definitions.

SPEC: the working spec at .adlc/specs/51-lens-derived-edges.md carries the full mechanism - detection (3.1), link/unlink generation (3.2), the symmetric delta (3.3), the refs envelope field with its three-step reciprocal precedence (3.4; bilateral derivation deferred), introspection truth (3.5; typed nested views deferred), evolution and legacy fossils (3.6).

Acceptance criteria: transcribed in the working spec, each naming its test path (fixture stores; Myk's own rehearsal against the live sync: container follows the deploy).

Merge tier: NEW CAPABILITY - the surface gains mutations and the envelope gains a field. Myk merges; the design is his own brief, so the PR's open questions are only whatever the build discovers.

Deferred follow-ups named in the spec: bilateral reciprocal derivation (3.4.2), typed nested view fields (3.5 stretch).
title: Lens-derived edge mutations - the write side generated as the adjoint of the read program
